subject: I made a website for Mayo's Barber Shop
body:
Hi there,

My name is Reid. I came across Mayo's Barber Shop on Google Maps and liked seeing a shop going strong since 1960 with 4.8 stars from 126 Google reviews. I noticed you guys don't have a website, just your Facebook page, so I made one for you to check out:

https://reidwcoleman.github.io/site-previews/mayos-barber-shop/

It already has your services, hours, a map and a request form. The photos are samples until yours go in. You can request to change anything you want, from the wording to the colors to the layout, and I'll update it for you.

If you like it, what would you be willing to pay for it? Any number helps, and there's no obligation at all.

Thanks,
Reid Coleman
reidwcoleman@gmail.com

{ADDRESS}
If you'd rather not hear from me, just reply "no thanks" and I won't email you again.
